newsitem.title: USA: San Francisco panel OKs bond assistance program.
newsitem.headline: San Francisco panel OKs bond assistance program.

text.p: San Francisco's finance committee has approved a $2.5 million bonding assistance program to aid small minority- and women-owned businesses, officials said on Thursday.
The program will guarantee loans and payment bonds of up to $750,000 to financial institutions, city officials said.

"The city is expanding contracting opportunities for minority, women and small businesses who would otherwise be unable to compete with some of the larger, more established contractors," said Supervisor Susan Leal. Leal chairs the finance committee, which reports to the Board of Supervisors.
The full Board will consider the bonding program in the coming weeks.
